manifest.title: Murmur · Luthier comparisons
manifest.acceptance: Experimental comparisons awaiting owner listening. Approved model-1/model-2 voices and the factory bank remain unchanged.
manifest.keyCandidate: Ordinary model-2 custom targets: each existing target gain multiplied by 3, capped at the existing limit of 3. Centers, widths, sources, envelopes, macros and ratios are unchanged. This is a conservative contour candidate, not a complete fix for weak KEY motion.
manifest.choirCandidate: Longer test-only loop plan retains requested near-unison beating more closely. It also changes repeated-noise period and whole-cycle formant motion quantization; this comparison does not isolate beating from all duration-dependent effects.
manifest.seamMetric: Keys.seamError between two independently synthesized adjacent settled cycles; reflected finish verified bit-identical against current probe for both comparison notes.
manifest.timingNote: Single JVM render excluding encoding and metrics. Cloud CPU/JIT timing, not phone latency. Long-loop render cost scales with duration.
manifest.hearing: No listening claim. Measurements do not approve the candidate sound.

clips.description: Approved short-loop policy rounds every operator to a whole cycle. At C2, operator 4 becomes unison.

clips.title: CHOIR · C2 · longer loop
clips.description: Experimental loop plan preserves the requested mild detune more closely. Repeat several wraps and compare the slow beating and moving mouth.

experimentalLoopPolicy.name: choir-beat-period-v1
experimentalLoopPolicy.rule: Nearest even root-cycle count to one cycle of requested operator-4 beating; nearest 16 output frames. Other operators use nearest whole cycles.
experimentalLoopPolicy.reproduction: MurmurLuthierAuditionGenerator.renderWithPlan using this basePatch and recorded loop plan; basePatch.render alone retains the approved short loop.
